text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, July 28 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant. 1 vessel due 29/7. No delays.
Hay Point - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 13 due by 14/8. No delays.
Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 37 due by 20/9. No delays.
Gladstone - Curragh mine in its 11th week of strike. Negotiations continue. Gordonstone coal senior management decided to close 1 of 2 long wall operations and 2 of 3 development mines.
R.G. Tanna - 1 Vessel loading, 1 waiting, 23 due by 20/9. No delays.
Barney Point - Berth vacant, 5 vessels due by 25/8. No delays.
Brisbane - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 1 due 2/8. No delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Hunter Valley no. 1 mine negotiations continue.
Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 20 waiting, 8 due by 5/8. 16-17 Days delay.
Dyke 4+5 - 2 Vessels loading, 15 waiting, 11 due by 6/8. 16 Days delay.
Port Kembla - Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 14 due by 31/8. 3-4 Days delay.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Shortage of lump and fines and Yandi fines continues. Berth A - Berthing/loading will stop for approx. 24-36 hours due to scheduled dredging along wharf face. 7 vessels anchored, 1 due 29/7. Berth B - Berthing/loading will stop for 24-36 hours due to dredging. 6 Vessels anchored, 1 due 28/7, 12 others due with no eta.
Goldsworthy (Finucane island) - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 1 due 29/7, 1 other due with no eta.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 7 anchored.
E.I. Island - 1 Vessel loading. Maintenance shutdown for 24 hours. 4 Vessels anchored.
Port Walcott - 16 Vessels due by 20/8.

July 30 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - Grain terminal currently carryout out extensive maintenance of shiploader. Grain berth also being fitted with cargo crane for handling bulk commodities for import and export to increase utility of No.5 wharf. One sorghum vessel due 8/8.
Gladstone - Three vessels due by 15/8.
Brisbane - Two wheat vessels due by 12/8.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One wheat vessel in port, 1 wheat due 2/8.

Port Kembla - One wheat vessel in port, 2 wheat due by 6/8. Berthing programme is based on grade of cargo receivals by rail. Grain corporation and union negotiating in Sydney, working overtime 30/7. Evening shift as requested. No midnight requested. Overtime issue has been resolved for the short term.
VICTORIA - Geelong - Three vessels due by 6/9.

Portland - Two vessels due by 6/8. From 11/8 to 25/8 maintenance will be carried out on new loader B, northern section of wharf shiploader rail, rail receival shed. Loading will be restricted to No.2 berth using old loader, no rail unloading will take place. Terminal wheat and barley receival capacity only by road during this period.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - No vessels due.
Port Adelaide - One wheat vessel due 8/8.
Thevenard - No vessels due.
Port Lincoln - Two due by 14/8.
Wallaroo, Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port Giles - One wheat vessel due 5/8.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - One loading wheat, 3 wheat due by 11/8.
Kwinana - Two wheat/canola vessels loading. 7 vessels due by 13/8. No loading 2/8-5/8 due to planned shiploader maintenance.
Albany - Three vessels due by 6/8.
Esperance - two barley vessels due by 9/8.
